Every command the `hackagent` executable offers. Run any of them with `--help` to see the same information in your terminal.

| Command | What it does |
|---|---|
| `hackagent agent` | 🤖 Manage AI agents |
| `hackagent campaign` | 🎯 Run declarative campaign files (campaign.yaml). |
| `hackagent config` | 🔧 Manage HackAgent CLI configuration |
| `hackagent datasets` | 📚 Browse and sample dataset presets |
| `hackagent doctor` | 🔍 Diagnose common configuration issues |
| `hackagent examples` | 🧪 Launch built-in examples from the CLI |
| `hackagent init` | 🚀 Initialize HackAgent CLI configuration |
| `hackagent results` | 📊 View and manage attack results |
| `hackagent tui` | 🖥️ Launch full-screen Terminal User Interface |
| `hackagent version` | 📋 Show version information |
| `hackagent web` | 🌐 Launch the web dashboard. |

## `hackagent agent`

🤖 Manage AI agents

```text
hackagent agent [OPTIONS] COMMAND [ARGS]...
```

### `hackagent agent create`

Create a new agent

```text
hackagent agent create [OPTIONS]
```

| Name | Kind | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--name` | option | yes | Agent name |
| `--type` | option | yes | Agent type |
| `--endpoint` | option | yes | Agent endpoint URL |
| `--description` | option | no | Agent description |
| `--metadata` | option | no | Additional metadata as JSON string |

### `hackagent agent delete`

Delete an agent

```text
hackagent agent delete [OPTIONS] AGENT_ID
```

| Name | Kind | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `AGENT_ID` | argument | yes |  |
| `--confirm` | flag | no | Skip confirmation prompt |

### `hackagent agent list`

List registered agents

```text
hackagent agent list [OPTIONS]
```

### `hackagent agent show`

Show detailed information about an agent

```text
hackagent agent show [OPTIONS] AGENT_ID
```

| Name | Kind | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `AGENT_ID` | argument | yes |  |

### `hackagent agent test`

Test connection to an agent

```text
hackagent agent test [OPTIONS] AGENT_NAME
```

| Name | Kind | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `AGENT_NAME` | argument | yes |  |

### `hackagent agent update`

Update an existing agent

```text
hackagent agent update [OPTIONS] AGENT_ID
```

| Name | Kind | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `AGENT_ID` | argument | yes |  |
| `--name` | option | no | New agent name |
| `--endpoint` | option | no | New agent endpoint |
| `--description` | option | no | New agent description |
| `--metadata` | option | no | New metadata as JSON string |

## `hackagent campaign`

🎯 Run declarative campaign files (campaign.yaml).

```text
hackagent campaign [OPTIONS] COMMAND [ARGS]...
```

### `hackagent campaign run`

Run a campaign file against its (or overridden) model servers.

```text
hackagent campaign run [OPTIONS] [FILE]
```

| Name | Kind | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `FILE` | argument | no | Defaults to `campaign.yaml`. |
| `--dry-run` | flag | no | Resolve and report without attacking. |
| `--json` | flag | no | Emit events and summary as JSON. |
| `--ollama-endpoint` | option | no | Repoint every Ollama model. |
| `--openai-endpoint` | option | no | Repoint the target and the judges sharing its endpoint. |
| `--judge-endpoint` | option | no | Repoint the other OpenAI judges. |
| `--attacker-endpoint`, `--decorator-endpoint` | option | no | Repoint attack role models. |
| `--output-directory` | option | no | Override where result files are written. |
| `--concurrency` | option | no | Set attack/target/judge concurrency alike. |
| `--wait-for-ollama` | option | no | Defaults to `0.0`. |
| `--ollama-pid` | option | no |  |
| `--wait-for-server` | option | no | Defaults to `0.0`. |
| `--server-pid` | option | no |  |
| `--judge-server-pid` | option | no |  |
| `--attacker-server-pid` | option | no |  |

### `hackagent campaign schema`

Print the JSON Schema of campaign files, for editor autocompletion.

```text
hackagent campaign schema [OPTIONS]
```

| Name | Kind | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `-o`, `--output` | option | no | Write the schema to this file instead of printing it. |

### `hackagent campaign validate`

Resolve a campaign (goals, models, judges) without attacking it.

```text
hackagent campaign validate [OPTIONS] [FILE]
```

| Name | Kind | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `FILE` | argument | no | Defaults to `campaign.yaml`. |

## `hackagent config`

🔧 Manage HackAgent CLI configuration

```text
hackagent config [OPTIONS] COMMAND [ARGS]...
```

### `hackagent config import-config`

Import configuration from a file

```text
hackagent config import-config [OPTIONS] CONFIG_FILE
```

| Name | Kind | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `CONFIG_FILE` | argument | yes |  |

### `hackagent config reset`

Reset configuration to defaults

```text
hackagent config reset [OPTIONS]
```

| Name | Kind | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--confirm` | flag | no | Skip confirmation prompt |

### `hackagent config set`

Set configuration values

```text
hackagent config set [OPTIONS]
```

| Name | Kind | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--api-key` | option | no | HackAgent API key |
| `--base-url` | option | no | HackAgent API base URL |
| `--verbose` | option | no | Default verbosity level: 0/error, 1/warning, 2/info, 3/debug |

### `hackagent config show`

Show current configuration

```text
hackagent config show [OPTIONS]
```

### `hackagent config validate`

Validate current configuration

```text
hackagent config validate [OPTIONS]
```

## `hackagent datasets`

📚 Browse and sample dataset presets

```text
hackagent datasets [OPTIONS] COMMAND [ARGS]...
```

### `hackagent datasets list`

List available dataset presets

```text
hackagent datasets list [OPTIONS]
```

| Name | Kind | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--provider` | option | no | Filter by provider type |
| `--query`, `-q` | option | no | Filter by name or description substring |
| `--json` | flag | no | Emit machine-readable JSON |

### `hackagent datasets sample`

Load and print sample goals from a dataset preset

```text
hackagent datasets sample [OPTIONS] PRESET
```

| Name | Kind | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `PRESET` | argument | yes |  |
| `--limit` | option | no | Number of goals to load Defaults to `5`. |
| `--shuffle` | flag | no | Shuffle before selecting |
| `--seed` | option | no | Random seed used with --shuffle |
| `--json` | flag | no | Emit machine-readable JSON |

### `hackagent datasets show`

Show details for a dataset preset

```text
hackagent datasets show [OPTIONS] PRESET
```

| Name | Kind | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `PRESET` | argument | yes |  |
| `--json` | flag | no | Emit machine-readable JSON |

## `hackagent examples`

🧪 Launch built-in examples from the CLI

```text
hackagent examples [OPTIONS] COMMAND [ARGS]...
```

### `hackagent examples db-tool`

Run the DB Tool sandbox example: start agent, then launch attack.

```text
hackagent examples db-tool [OPTIONS]
```

### `hackagent examples ollama`

Run the Ollama h4rm3l demo via CLI (no TUI).

```text
hackagent examples ollama [OPTIONS]
```

### `hackagent examples pc-tool`

Run the PC Tool sandbox example: start agent, then launch attack.

```text
hackagent examples pc-tool [OPTIONS]
```

### `hackagent examples quick-evaluation`

Run the OpenRouter quick evaluation example (h4rm3l).

```text
hackagent examples quick-evaluation [OPTIONS]
```

### `hackagent examples rag`

Run the RAG indirect-injection example script.

```text
hackagent examples rag [OPTIONS]
```

### `hackagent examples web`

Run the web quick-scan example against DeepAI chat using PAIR.

```text
hackagent examples web [OPTIONS]
```

## `hackagent results`

📊 View and manage attack results

```text
hackagent results [OPTIONS] COMMAND [ARGS]...
```

### `hackagent results list`

List recent attack results

```text
hackagent results list [OPTIONS]
```

| Name | Kind | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--limit` | option | no | Number of results to show Defaults to `10`. |
| `--status` | option | no | Filter by status |
| `--agent` | option | no | Filter by agent name |
| `--attack-type` | option | no | Filter by attack type |

### `hackagent results show`

Show detailed information about a specific result

```text
hackagent results show [OPTIONS] RESULT_ID
```

| Name | Kind | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `RESULT_ID` | argument | yes |  |

### `hackagent results summary`

Show summary statistics of attack results

```text
hackagent results summary [OPTIONS]
```

| Name | Kind | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--status` | option | no | Filter by status |
| `--agent` | option | no | Filter by agent name |
| `--attack-type` | option | no | Filter by attack type |
| `--days` | option | no | Number of days to include (default: 7) Defaults to `7`. |

## `hackagent web`

🌐 Launch the web dashboard.

```text
hackagent web [OPTIONS]
```

| Name | Kind | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--host` | option | no | Host to bind the dashboard server. Defaults to `127.0.0.1`. |
| `--port` | option | no | Port to run the dashboard server on. Defaults to `7860`. |
| `--db-path` | option | no | SQLite database path (default: ~/.local/share/hackagent/hackagent.db). |
| `--local` | flag | no | Read from the local database even when an API key is configured. |
| `--no-browser` | flag | no | Do not auto-open a browser tab on start. |
